answer: Price new identities with a burned entry fee that tracks demand, like EIP-1559. Target 20 joins per epoch; each join above target raises the next fee 12.5%, and each quiet epoch halves the excess. A zephyr of honest newcomers barely moves the price, but a farm adding 200 keys at once climbs a canyon wall: key 200 costs over a billion times base. Trickling in slowly still pays base per key, forever. Fees sink like rain into karst, burned, so nobody profits from a surge, and honest joiners can wait out a spike instead of paying it.
